grades.quote: When MXR is in effect at the effective privilege mode where explicit memory access is performed, pointer masking does not apply.
grades.reason: Only mentions MXR's interaction with pointer masking (masking is not applied when MXR is in effect). It does not say how MXR affects loads from execute-only pages, so it is auxiliary.

grades.quote: When MXR=0, only loads from pages marked readable (R=1 in Figure 67) will succeed. When MXR=1, loads from pages marked either readable or executable (R=1 or X=1) will succeed.
grades.reason: Directly states MXR's effect. With MXR=0 only readable pages can be loaded from. With MXR=1 loads from executable pages (X=1) also succeed, which covers execute-only pages. It also notes MXR has no effect without page-based virtual memory.
Describes the hypervisor-extension changes to mstatus. MXR appears only as a field name in a register figure, with no explanation of its effect on loads from execute-only pages.

grades.quote: Clarified that MXR affects only explicit memory accesses.
grades.reason: A preface changelog line saying MXR affects only explicit memory accesses. This is a minor scope clarification and does not describe the effect on execute-only pages.
